nodes.name: positive_determinant_matrix_data_exists_unique
nodes.summary: Construct the unique positive absolute-determinant data of every positive-dimensional square matrix with an actual nonzero full determinant.

nodes.name: SignedDeterminantNodeCode
nodes.summary: An injective packed dimension/matrix/value record, with existential sharing of the actual intermediate pairing codes.

nodes.name: BetaAt
nodes.summary: x is the bounded beta-decoded value at index i.

nodes.name: SignedDeterminantNodeAt
nodes.summary: An actual determinant-node record decoded from a beta history.

nodes.name: Lt
nodes.summary: Witness-defined strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: Le
nodes.summary: Witness-defined non-strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: MatrixSkipIndex
nodes.summary: The unique order-preserving source coordinate that skips one genuinely deleted matrix row or column.

nodes.name: Beta
nodes.summary: Exact hygienic Gödel-beta extraction; a signature-identical alias of checked BetaAt.

nodes.name: MatrixMinorCell
nodes.summary: The exact beta-decoded source entry after independently skipping the removed row and column.

nodes.name: MatrixMinorPrefix
nodes.summary: One complete row-major beta code containing every genuine skipped-row/skipped-column matrix entry.

nodes.name: SignedMatrixMinor
nodes.summary: Both complete independently beta-coded natural components of a genuine signed square cofactor minor.

nodes.name: SignedDeterminantChildPrefix
nodes.summary: Every selected column has a genuine smaller cofactor matrix, an evaluating node strictly earlier than the parent, and its actual two determinant components.

nodes.name: Even
nodes.summary: n has an even decomposition.

nodes.name: Odd
nodes.summary: n has an odd decomposition.

nodes.name: SignedAlternatingCofactorTerm
nodes.summary: The exact positive/negative natural-pair product with signs exchanged precisely at odd cofactor positions.

nodes.name: SignedAlternatingProductPrefix
nodes.summary: Complete beta-coded positive and negative streams of every exact signed parity-adjusted row/cofactor product.

nodes.name: Sum
nodes.summary: z is the sum of a beta-coded prefix of length l.

nodes.name: SignedAlternatingCofactorFold
nodes.summary: The two uniquely determined subtraction-free finite sums of an arbitrary signed alternating Laplace fold.

nodes.name: SignedDeterminantLocalStep
nodes.summary: Either the exact empty value (1,0), or a complete genuine cofactor-child family and its parity-correct first-row alternating fold.

nodes.name: SignedDeterminantHistory
nodes.summary: Every node in an actual finite history satisfies its genuine strict-child determinant rule; cyclic or supplied-value evaluations are excluded.

nodes.name: SignedRecursiveDeterminant
nodes.summary: An actual evaluating root in a finite cofactor DAG for an arbitrary-dimensional signed matrix; its mathematical value is p−n.

nodes.name: SignedEvaluatedCofactors
nodes.summary: Actual determinants of every genuine first-row minor are stored in the cofactor streams, not assumed as unrelated values.

nodes.name: SignedMatrixPrefixEquality
nodes.summary: Pointwise equality of both actual component streams of two square matrices; this is stronger than equality only of their signed differences.

nodes.name: UniformBetaPrefixBox
nodes.summary: One fixed scale c and positive finite code bound T recode every actual length-l prefix with values below B; completeness is part of the relation.

nodes.name: FiniteMatrixSelector
nodes.summary: Actual beta-decoded matrix coordinates are all below B and pairwise distinct; the list may be empty.

nodes.name: SignedSelectedSubmatrix
nodes.summary: Every entry of both components of the q-by-q output is the actual row-major parent entry selected by the two coordinate streams.

nodes.name: SignedSelectedDeterminant
nodes.summary: An actual selected submatrix and its unrestricted recursive determinant, not a supplied table of purported minor values.

nodes.name: NonzeroSelectedMinor
nodes.summary: Two distinct in-range coordinate selectors and an actual selected determinant whose positive and negative components differ.

nodes.name: NonzeroMatrixMinor
nodes.summary: There exist genuine bounded injective row and column selectors witnessing a nonzero minor of order q.

nodes.name: AllSignedMinorsZero
nodes.summary: Every genuine selected minor of order q has zero integer determinant, for all actual selector encodings and determinant evaluations.

nodes.name: RectangularMatrixRank
nodes.summary: A rank bounded by both dimensions, an actual nonzero minor of that order, and vanishing of every higher-order minor; the empty determinant supplies rank zero.

nodes.name: IntegerVectorEqual
nodes.summary: Coordinatewise equality of signed differences by balanced equality; different positive/negative representations may denote the same integer vector.

nodes.name: IntegerVectorZero
nodes.summary: Every actual positive component equals its negative component, so each represented integer is zero.

nodes.name: IntegerVectorAdd
nodes.summary: Actual coordinatewise addition of represented signed integers, expressed without subtraction or a preferred pair representation.

nodes.name: IntegerVectorNegate
nodes.summary: The target equals the vector obtained by swapping the two source components, in integer-difference equality.

nodes.name: MatrixAffineSlice
nodes.summary: A complete beta-coded affine matrix slice whose exact target entry at i equals the source entry at s+d*i.

nodes.name: DotProduct
nodes.summary: The witnessed sum of the pointwise products of two beta-coded natural vectors.

nodes.name: MatrixProductCell
nodes.summary: An exact natural matrix multiplication cell with witnessed beta-coded row, column and finite dot product.

nodes.name: MatrixProductPrefix
nodes.summary: Every bounded row-major natural matrix product cell together with its exact coordinate, strict column bound and output beta witness.

nodes.name: MatrixPointwiseAdd
nodes.summary: The complete beta-coded pointwise sum of two exact bounded natural vector prefixes.

nodes.name: SignedMatrixProduct
nodes.summary: The exact complete signed finite matrix product: four natural coded products and two beta-coded pointwise-summed positive/negative output matrices.

nodes.name: IntegerMatrixVectorProduct
nodes.summary: An actual coded signed matrix product of output width one, compared to the requested output by integer-vector equality.

nodes.name: IntegerColumnSpan
nodes.summary: Actual finite signed coefficient codes witness the output as an integer linear combination of the matrix columns; no independence, index, or covolume is assumed.

nodes.name: IntegerMatrixEntrywiseEqual
nodes.summary: Genuine signed-integer equality at every actual row-major entry of two r-by-w matrices, reusing integer-vector equality at length r*w.

nodes.name: AbsoluteRecursiveDeterminant
nodes.summary: An actual recursive signed determinant and its natural absolute difference D, with either sign orientation witnessed.

nodes.name: PositiveDeterminantMatrixData
nodes.summary: A positive-dimensional integral square matrix with actual positive absolute determinant D. Full rank is a proved consequence; lattice index or geometric covolume equality is not asserted.

nodes.name: IdentityMatrixSelector
nodes.summary: The actual beta-decoded coordinate list 0,1,…,l−1; its boundedness, injectivity, and full-matrix selection are proved separately.
